name: MonarchBadge
title: Badge
summary: A short status label with tones neutral, accent, info, success, warning, danger and ai, and variants subtle, solid and outline.
whenToUse: To show the status of an item in one or two words.
whenNotToUse: Not for counts on tab bar items (use the system badge modifier) and not as a button.
api: init(_ text: String, tone: MonarchTone = .neutral, variant: MonarchBadgeVariant = .subtle, systemImage: String? = nil, size: MonarchBadgeSize = .md, dot: Bool = false)

options.name: tone
options.description: neutral, accent, info, success, warning, danger or ai.

options.name: dot
options.description: Draws a small status dot before the text, in the text colour.

appearance: Subtle is a tinted capsule with strong-coloured text, solid a filled capsule, outline a bordered capsule with no fill. Colours come from the tone roles of the theme.
platformNotes: The accent tone, the leading status dot and the small size are offered as on the web.
accessibility: Read as its text, so the text must carry the meaning without the colour.
The text scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: Long text wraps inside the capsule; keep it to one or two words.
